summary: Body of a 37-year-old Aspen resident recovered from the Conundrum Couloir between Castle and Conundrum Peaks after a two-day search; reported overdue by his employer July 30, MRA teams deployed July 31 but weather prevented recovery. Hiker wore no mountaineering boots, crampons, or helmet.
location: Conundrum Couloir, between Castle Peak and Conundrum Peak
notes: MRA FB mission post (posted 2023-08-03; Pitkin SO case 23P007579). Org-post source per user rule 2026-09-17; permalink opened live by browser task. 2026-09-18: merged additional MRA FB post (Conundrum Couloir recovery).
